Bison at the Grand Tetons⁠
⁠
The Team at Taylor Photography is excited to be offering a 5 day landscape photography workshop in the Grand Teton mountains of Wyoming. Grand Teton National Park is home to some of the most awe-inspiring natural beauty in the United States.
⁠
Come join us September 17-21 2022. Link in profile.⁠
⁠
Check out our website linked in our profile for:⁠
• Photography & Processing Workshops⁠
• Fine Art Prints⁠
• Online Processing Sessions⁠
• Night Photography Presentations⁠
• And More …⁠

🎬...Miracle Workers (2019–present) – A comedy anthology series that reinvents itself every season with a completely new setting and characters while keeping the same core cast. From heaven and medieval times to the Wild West and even dystopian futures, each season tells a standalone story.

That format is what keeps the show fresh. It allows the actors to transform into wildly different roles each time, making the comedy unpredictable—you’re never watching the same show twice, even though the faces stay familiar.

📺 Where to watch: Prime Video, Apple TV

node.text:
日本利用压电瓷砖将脚步转化为电能。这些瓷砖捕捉来自你脚步的动能。当你行走时，你的重量和动作会对瓷砖产生压力。瓷砖会轻微弯曲，从而产生机械应力。瓷砖内部的压电材料将这种应力转化力电能。每一步都会产生少量电荷，而数百万步结合在一起就能产生足够的电力来驱动LED 灯、数字显示屏和传感器。在像涩谷车站这样繁忙的地方，每天大约有240万个脚步为这一系统作出贡献。
这些电能可以被储存或立即使用，从而减少对传统电力来源的依赖，并支持可持续的城市基础设施。
这种方法将日常运动转化为实用的可再生能源 ＃日本 #知识＃事实 #你知道吗 #推荐 #科技 #创新＃历史 #技术 #实验 #热门

#japan🇯🇵 Follow

この速度に達すると、もはや陸上を移動しているのではなく、音速で移動していることになります。

このシミュレーションは、マッハ1、つまり時速約 1,330kmで日本を超音速鉄道で旅するとどのような感じになるかを視覚化したものです。現在、日本の最速列車は約時速320kmで運行されており、超 در سواحل انزونزی ماهیگیری موجودی را در ساحل کشف کرد که محلی ها آن را ماهی زامبی نامیدند جالب اینجاست که این ماهی کاملا فاقد اندامهای داخلی است اما همچنان حرکت میکند و حتی شنا میکند که سوال واقعی و منطقی را به وجود میآورد چگونه چنین چیزی ممکن است؟ زیست شناسان میگویند احتمالا درو

node.text:
Uma jovem registrou o primeiro dia de estágio da irmã na prefeitura de forma inusitada. No vídeo, Kaila aparece toda arrumada, com look formal, bolsa no ombro e salto alto fino, pronta para iniciar a nova etapa profissional. Antes de sair, ela se despede com um animado “adiós” e segue caminho para o trabalho… de bicicleta.

O contraste entre o visual elegante e o meio de transporte improvisado chamou a atenção e divertiu internautas. Nos comentários, usuários compartilharam experiências parecidas do início da vida profissional e incentivaram a jovem. “Comecei indo de ônibus! Hoje tenho um Fiat 500. Fé, amigas!”, escreveu um perfil. Outro comentou: “A confiança de pedalar de salto e calça longa é o que eu preciso na vida”.
Parabéns está menina vai ter muito sucesso
Was I the only one worried about there pants catching in between the chain and the crankset? Instead of looking at her ass? She's Def going to learn a lesson or two very soon... No helmet either....
I was waiting for her to crash (why didn't she crashed ?)
O bike ta com folga na catraca ai o 🤦🏾‍♂️ mas vai com Deus moça

Relationship situations be like 👀

node.text:
Model Kendall Jenner and actor Nicholas Galitzine recently sparked buzz as a fashionable pair at Milan Fashion Week in February 2026. They were spotted together at the Emporio Armani show, seated in the front row and attending the "Power of You" fragrance party, prompting online interest in their appearances and interaction.

Milan Fashion Week 2026 Highlights
• Emporio Armani Show: Jenner and Galitzine appeared together, with spectators noting their style and chemistry, according to Instagram posts.
• "Power Of You" Party: The pair reunited later in the evening to celebrate the label's fragrance, as described in Instagram posts and Instagram posts.
• Social Media Interest: Their appearances were widely shared by fashion media, with onlookers describing them as a "major front-row appearance" or "pairings" with strong chemistry, reports Instagram posts and Instagram posts.

Background Information
• Nicholas Galitzine: A British actor known for roles in films like Cinderella (2021) and TV projects such as George & Mary, according to Camila Cabello Wiki | Fandom and IMDb.
• Kendall Jenner: A high-profile fashion model and member of the Jenner/Kardashian family.

Bof les Kardashian, franchement je ne sais pas si ce sont des belles personnes.
Je ne vois pas Nicolas avec cette femme. Un peu trop artificielle.

Japan 🇯🇵 is transforming earthquakes from a deadly threat into a challenge that technology can overcome.

Imagine a building that doesn’t fight an earthquake… it simply rises above it.

Engineers in Japan are creating advanced earthquake-resistant structures that can lift slightly off the ground during strong tremors. As soon as sensors detect the first vibrations, high-pressure air is released beneath the building, forming a cushion that raises it a few centimeters.

For those critical moments, the structure is no longer directly connected to the shaking ground. Instead, it floats on a thin layer of air, reducing the impact that typically causes destruction.

The result? Greater stability. Safer buildings. Protected lives.

In a country that faces thousands of earthquakes every year, Japan continues to prove that innovation can turn danger into protection.

🎬

What if trains moved faster than sound? 🚀🌍
This mind-bending simulation takes you across Japan at Mach 1 (1,330 km/h) — faster than anything on rails today.

From 320 km/h bullet trains to 600 km/h maglev... and beyond into the future of vacuum tubes and near-silent supersonic travel — this is what tomorrow could look like. 🚄✨

Blink, and you’ve crossed the country.

#FutureTravel #Supersonic #AnimeVibes #TechEvolution #ViralReels
Na vida real ela se aproximou dele e  aconteceu o mesmo😂

Daddario mogged him 😍💯
..
Alexandra Daddario is an famous Hollywood actress known for her unique and piercing eyes, a feature that instantly sets her apart on screen. Born in 1986 in New York City and raised around law and politics, she turned to acting early, studying at the Professional Children’s School and making stage rounds before landing film work. She’s best known for:
‎- _Percy Jackson_ (2010)
‎- _Baywatch_ (2017)
‎- _Texas Chainsaw 3D_ (2013)
‎- _San Andreas_ (2015)
‎- _The White Lotus_ series (2021)
‎
‎Those credits trace a path from YA fantasy to broad comedy and then to darker, prestige drama—she earned an Emmy nomination for _The White Lotus_. Off camera she keeps a low profile, but the mix of model poise and understated intensity keeps her moving smoothly between blockbusters and character-driven projects.
..
..

Regarding Alexandra Daddario, my perspective is not particularly favorable based on both personal impressions and public observations. While she presents herself warmly in media appearances, that demeanor can come across differently in unscripted settings. For example, at San Diego Comic-Con, I observed what felt like limited engagement with fans unless cameras were present.

I also find it notable that much of the imagery circulated online tends to be from earlier in her career rather than more recent representations. Additionally, aspects of her personal life and public image—such as selective sharing on social media—raise questions about how she chooses to present herself to the public.

From a professional standpoint, I do not view her filmography as especially distinguished, and I believe many of her roles have emphasized appearance over performance. In my opinion, her projects have not consistently demonstrated standout critical or commercial success, and shows like Mayfair Witches have received mixed to negative reactions from audiences.

Overall, my assessment is that her public persona and career achievements do not align with the level of attention she often receives.

🎬 Movie: Southpaw (2015)
⭐ Genre: Sports / Drama
⏳ Runtime: 2h 4m
🌟 Rating: 7.4/10
☀️ Cast: Jake Gyllenhaal, Rachel McAdams, Forest Whitaker, Oona Laurence
📖 Brief Overview:
The story follows Billy “The Great” Hope, an undefeated professional boxer whose world shatters after a tragic accident claims the life of his wife. After losing his career, his house, and custody of his daughter, he must train with a humble coach to reclaim his life and family.
Why It’s Loved:
Audiences are drawn to Jake Gyllenhaal’s incredible physical transformation and raw, emotional performance. It’s a classic underdog story that focuses more on the internal battle of grief and fatherhood than just the action in the ring.
My Opinion:
It’s a heavy, visceral experience. While the “downward spiral” trope is familiar, the chemistry between Gyllenhaal and McAdams (as seen in your clip) makes the stakes feel incredibly high. It’s a masterclass in acting that will likely leave you in tears.

node.text:
Always the low quality Reels

Did you know your "Moral Compass" has an off switch? 🧭🔌

​I was reading about a study that proves how high-arousal states (like anger, excitement, or attraction) completely flip our rational decision-making.

​In marketing, we see this all the time. When a consumer is emotionally "hot," their long-term logic disappears. That’s why impulsive buys happen! 🧠💥

​Follow for more deep dives into the psychology of how we think and buy.

​#RajPanchalThinks #ConsumerPsychology #MarketingMindset #HumanBehavior #Neuromarketing DecisionMaking
You said so much without actually telling anything at all.

The dance scene between Monica Bellucci and Vincent Cassel in L’Appartement (1996) stands as one of the film’s most quietly powerful moments. Set within a story built on obsession and misdirection, it introduces a pause where emotion replaces narrative momentum.

Directed by Gilles Mimouni, the film received a generally positive critical response upon release, with particular praise directed toward its atmospheric storytelling and emotional complexity. 

Critics highlighted its ability to blend romance, thriller, and psychological drama without fully committing to any single genre, which gave it an unpredictable and slightly disorienting quality that matched its themes. 

However, some reviews noted that the narrative structure could feel deliberately convoluted, relying heavily on coincidence and perspective shifts that may not appeal to all audiences.

Despite this, L’Appartement has grown in reputation over time, especially among viewers drawn to European cinema of the 1990s. The performances of Monica Bellucci and Vincent Cassel are often singled out as central to the film’s lasting impact, with their on-screen chemistry later taking on added cultural significance.

Fun fact: Monica Bellucci and Vincent Cassel met while filming L’Appartement and later went on to marry in 1999, becoming one of European cinema’s most high-profile couples before divorcing in 2013.

😂😂😂😂😂
Billiards is not just a game — it’s an art 🎱
An art built on focus, patience, and precise angle calculation.
Behind every successful shot, there is strategy, planning, and full control of power and direction.

In this video, I’m sharing a glimpse of my billiards skills —
from reading the table,
to choosing the right shot,
and executing it with confidence and calmness.

There is no such thing as luck on a billiards table.
Only experience built over time,
mistakes that turn into lessons,
and skills that grow with every match.

If you’re a true billiards fan
and appreciate clean play and calculated shots,
follow the page and let’s level up together 🎯

Drop your opinion in the comments:
Was the shot well calculated?
And what move would you like to see in the next video? 👇🔥

Halle Berry is a groundbreaking American actress, producer, and former beauty queen who made history as the first African American woman to win the Academy Award for Best Actress for her performance in Monster's Ball (2001). Born Halle Maria Berry on August 14, 1966, in Cleveland, Ohio, she began her career as a model and pageant titleholder, winning Miss Teen All-American and finishing as first runner-up in Miss USA 1986. 

Her acclaimed filmography includes iconic roles such as Storm in the X-Men franchise, Jinx in Die Another Day, and the title character in Catwoman. In addition to her Oscar, Berry has received Emmy and Golden Globe Awards for her portrayal of Dorothy Dandridge in the 1999 HBO biopic Introducing Dorothy Dandridge, cementing her status as a Hollywood icon and one of the highest-paid actresses in the industry.

Japan: Footsteps to Electricity#🇯🇵

Japan uses piezoelectric tiles to turn footsteps into energy. In busy places like Shibuya Station, millions of steps power LED lights and displays—a smart step toward sustainable cities.

Last year being broke.

日本，研究人员正在研发一种**“自愈合混凝土”**。这种材料中加入了特殊的细菌和营养物质，当墙体或道路出现裂缝时，空气和水分进入裂缝，细菌就会被激活。

这些细菌会产生石灰石，自动填补裂缝，让混凝土“自己修好自己”😲

这种技术可以：
❓延长建筑和道路的使用寿命
❓大幅降低维修成本
❓减少建筑垃圾和资源浪费

在一些试验项目中，细小裂缝几周内就能自动消失 🌱。
科技不只是创造新东西，
也在教材料学会“自我修复”🌍

未来的城市，
或许不再需要频繁维修，
而是会慢慢“自己痊愈”✨

#日本 #科技 #创新 #未来城市 #环保 可持续 你知道吗

🇯🇵 이 속도에 도달하면 더 이상 지상 이동이 아니라 음속으로 전진하는 것입니다 🚀🌍 이 시뮬레이션은 일본에서 마하 1(약 시속 1,330km)의 초음속 열차를 타고 이동할 때 어떤 모습일지를 보여줍니다. 현재 일본의 가장 빠른 열차는 약 시속 320km로 운행되고 있으며, 초고속 자기부상열차와 같은 첨단 실험 플랫폼에서는 통제된 환경에서 시속 600km 이상의 속도도 달성되었습니다.이 시뮬레이션은 현재 수준을 훨씬 넘어, 현대 철도 개념이 진정한 초고속 시스템으로 발전할 미래를 탐구합니다. 이 속도를 달성하기 위해서는 단순한 출력만으로는 충분하지 않습니다. 엔지니어들은 초고속 운행에서 가장 큰 제한 요소인 공기 저항을 제거하기 위해 자기부상 기술, 마찰이 거의 없는 가이드 레일, 그리고 진공 또는 저압 튜브 시스템을 연구하고 있습니다.마하급 속도에서는 작은 공기 교란도 심각한 구조적 문제가 될 수 있습니다. 따라서 미래의 초음속 철도 개념은 고정밀 유도 시스템, AI 기반 안정화 기술, 그리고 수백 킬로미터에 걸쳐 밀리미터 단위의 오차만 허용하는 인프라에 의존하게 될 것입니다.이 기술이 실현된다면, 현재 몇 시간이 걸리는 이동이 몇 분으로 단축되어 통근 방식, 지역 경제, 그리고 대도시 간 연결 방식에 혁신적인 변화를 가져올 수 있습니다.기술을 좋아하시나요?

come si diventa un personaggio ..

Ti odieranno @figaro_barber_salon_ 🙈
Un om frumos , este frumos oricum!😍
Você fica lindo até careca Yaman 😍 RJ 🇧🇷
No tenía amor platónico hasta que vi a este hombre me encanta 😊

❤️Hay algo en Can Yaman que nunca pasa desapercibido… pero cuando llevaba barba, tenía un encanto aún más irresistible. Esa mezcla de mirada intensa, sonrisa segura y ese toque salvaje hacía que cada foto pareciera una escena de película.
Para muchas, esa barba no era solo un estilo: era parte de su esencia, de ese aire masculino y magnético que despertaba suspiros sin esfuerzo. Hoy sigue siendo increíblemente atractivo, pero hay una nostalgia inevitable al recordar esa etapa en la que su imagen tenía un carácter más indomable, más apasionado.
Porque sí… Can Yaman siempre impacta, pero con barba… simplemente dejaba huella. Eres mi actor turco italiano favorito el de la mirada cautivadora y esa sonrisa seductora 💋 pero quiero verte con barba te saludo desde mi hermosa Venezuela -Barinas 🇻🇪🫶🏻🫂😘💝🇻🇪
Ay Canyaman, si vinieras a Cuba y mi mamá te pudiera ver
Você fica lindo até careca Yaman 😍 RJ 🇧🇷
Un om frumos , este frumos oricum!😍

@umax.app Lorenzo Zurzolo is an Italian actor and model born on March 21, 2000, who gained international recognition for his role as Niccolò Govender in Netflix’s Baby. Known for his tall, lean frame, sharp jawline, hollow cheeks, and intense, brooding eyes, he quickly became a fashion and youth icon beyond just acting. His on-screen presence is quiet yet magnetic, often portraying emotionally complex and introspective characters. Alongside Baby, he has appeared in films and series like Summertime and Sotto il sole di Riccione, while also building a strong presence in high-fashion modeling. Lorenzo represents a modern, minimalist form of charisma—subtle, controlled, and effortlessly striking.

node.text:
Modesty looks different for everyone. For some it’s hijab, for others it’s abaya and for some, it’s a personal choice that doesn’t fit your definition. And that’s okay.
She’s a model and an actress, not a religious authority so why are so many people targeting just one woman when this is common across the industry?

Criticism is fine, but at least be consistent. The same people who obsess over a woman’s clothes stay silent when creators promote hate, normalize cheating, or spread vulgar content online. Where is that energy then?

And let’s be honest if given an opportunity, would these same critics refuse to work with actresses based on what they wear?

Stop policing women’s choices just to gain attention. If you really care about values, start calling out real issues not someone’s outfit
.
.
.

node.text:
After Erum Akhtar alleged that her ‘Sanwal Yaar Piya’ co-star Dur-e-Fishan Saleem was unprofessional on set and caused delays, 7th Sky Entertainment, the production house behind the drama led by Abdullah Kadwani and Asad Qureshi, has now responded to the claims.

7th Sky Entertainment’s official Instagram handle has issued a response in support of Dur-e-Fishan. They state that she has consistently demonstrated a strong sense of professionalism and dedication, adding that artists often put in effort beyond what is visible and that public commentary can sometimes feel unfair. #Durefishan #ErumAkhtar #AbdullahKadwani #AsadQureshi (📸: @365.newspk)
Well she has told on air that she hates working and does NOT work more than necessary so this could be true!
Aunty ka jealousy plot fail hugya
Ramzan mein Roze ke sath acting krna Gair mardon ke sath phir roza kese hua Roze ki bhi kuch rules hain and durefishan NE boht Acha kiya well done @durefishans ❤
Хавьер Бардем и Пенелопа Крус ощущаются как Киндер Буэно
